newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products - gas oil flat, fuel slips more.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - gas oil flat, fuel slips more.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Tuesday, with gas oil flat but fuel oil continuing to slide, dealers said.

Heating oil barges were broadly flat as a dip in premiums counteracted the slight rise of IPE February futures. January loadings were offered at around IPE Feb +$4 fob ARA. First half February offers were at the same level.

High sulphur fuel oil continued to suffer from excess supply. Two prompt barges traded at $91 fob ARA, around $3 down from Monday's close, as suppliers tried to shift product before the end of the month. Bunker demand stayed low.
